verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents a Slack channel monitor that watches for @openhands mentions and opens a conversation with the message context, replying when finished — this directly supports tagging an agent in a chat thread to delegate a task. However, evidence doesn't show threaded discussion/back-and-forth delegation within the same thread beyond the initial mention-triggered conversation, nor integration with other chat tools (Teams, Discord) or richer bug-triage dialogue in-thread. missing for 10: evidence of multi-turn in-thread discussion after tagging, support for chat platforms beyond Slack, and hands-on/independent confirmation of the Slack integration working as described.
